title: Madison Cottage | 30a Cottage Rental | 30a Beach Properties – 30A Beach Properties
meta_description: Located south of 30a in Rosemary Beach. Madison Cottage is close to the Barbados Pool, beach, and shops. Click here to learn more about this 4-bed property today!
description_expanded:
The Madison Cottage is located south of 30-A in Rosemary Beach. It is directly across from the Barbados Pool, and close to the beach and shops. Features include a 4 bedroom / 5.5 bath cottage (plus 1 BR carriage house, rented separately). Two courtyards and outdoor Viking Grill complement the exterior. Newly refurnished, this family friendly home is clean and spacious.

All towels, bed linens, blankets, comforters, and pillow/mattress protectors are professionally laundered for every new reservation!

301 West Water Street, Rosemary Beach

Sleeps 13

3 kings

7 bunks

*pack and play, and highchair included

1 Garage Parking Space, Fits Suv: Tahoe, X7, Expedition. Extended suvs will not fit. Passes for street parking additional cars provided.

We provide passes to access all 4 Rosemary Beach Community pools (one of which is directly across from Madison Cottage), and any of the 9 Beach Walkovers

The three story floor plan has been designed to accommodate large groups, but is also very comfortable for smaller groups too!

Located south of 30-A, directly across from the Barbados Pool

1 minute walk to the beach walkover

Gulf views from 2nd floor master and 3rd floor bunk balcony

Well-appointed 4 bedroom, 3000 sf home sleeps 13 in beds. Each bedroom has its own ensuite bathroom. The third floor oversized bunk room has two bathrooms. Hardwood flooring on all three floors.

For an additional fee, the Madison carriage sleeps 3-4 (VRBO# 1748404) and is rented separately.

First floor:

Large, bright, open floor plan

Gourmet Viking kitchen

Two kitchen islands, 6-burner gas stove, large refrigerator, two sinks, microwave, granite countertops

Dining room

Family room with two sofas

Brand new 65" Smart TV and Wi-Fi

Wet bar with wine cooler, sink and ice maker

Powder room bathroom

Walk-in pantry off the kitchen

Built-in desk with games, DVDs, puzzles, game table

Second floor:

3 king bedrooms, private baths with full bathrooms & tubs

Laundry room with large washer/dryer, laundry sink, iron and ironing board.

Third floor:

7 built-in bunks

2 full bathrooms

Large flat screen TV and DVD player

The two outdoor patio areas provides a pleasant atmosphere for socializing with family and friends. Furnished with teak table/chairs and sofas. Outdoor Viking gas grill.

301 West Water Street is south of 30-A, a 1 to 2 minute walk from Rosemary Beach's finest restaurants. It is directly across from the Barbados Pool (one of four pools in Rosemary Beach, including 1 indoor) and just seven homes north of the gulf with gulf views from the balconies. Our beach access is walkover 'I'.

No pets

No smoking

Take part in the many activities of Rosemary Beach with 2 pools on the beach side and 2 more pools (including an indoor pool) on the north side. Enjoy a stroll on the 2.3mi Fitness and Walking Trails throughout Rosemary Beach. There are 2 outdoor children's play areas. Tennis and fitness centers are available by daily fee.
